decisive_items: a granulomatous lesion of the urinary bladder
a well-defined soft-tissue–density lesion with calcific specks along the anterosuperior bladder wall
heterogeneous enhancement in the early arterial and venous phases
response.rationale: The presence of a granulomatous lesion and calcific specks in the bladder wall, along with heterogeneous enhancement, suggests malacoplakia as the most likely diagnosis, although transitional cell carcinoma is a close runner-up due to the neoplastic appearance of the lesion.

rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for urinary bladder cancer beyond the presence of a polypoidal lesion.
Endometriosis is less likely due to the absence of specific symptoms and the location of the lesion in the bladder wall.
Urinary Bladder Endometriosis is less likely due to the absence of specific symptoms and the location of the lesion in the bladder wall, although it shares some similarities with the champion.
